svg.title: Dispatch: qualify this invocation before submitting effects
svg.desc: The generator owns the contract, request identity, pending draw and lifetime claims
svg.text: Dispatch: qualify this invocation before submitting effects
The generator owns the contract, request identity, pending draw and lifetime claims
1. Validate the public input
Shape / layout / dtype / policy / bounds
Device/context and allocation generation
Invalid data rejects; no unsafe fallback
2. Select and retain an eligible path
Qualified fused graph or fused eager
Valid unsupported work → ordinary path
Eligibility and lifetime claims acquired together
3. Track the submitted attempt
Producer dependency → work → consumers
Keep operands / workspace / outputs alive
An enqueue return is not completion
4. Recover according to crossed boundary
Proven not submitted: qualified retry possible
Unknown completion: retain / quarantine
No blind duplicate fallback after submission
A graph miss differs from invalid input; fallback must preserve useful computation.
A completed private sampler retry retains the same logical uniform and commit identity.
